title: Website / Introducing the new look
slide_intent: Explain a visual change in familiar terms because existing users need continuity while meeting a new identity.
strategic_value: The yellow announcement page can connect Mailchimp’s evolving product scope with a recognizable visual voice.
demonstration: A browser mockup combines navigation, a centered redesign headline and paragraph on yellow with a surreal gray-and-black scene below.
practical_value: Compare how a redesign announcement combines explanation with a specimen of the new style.

content_islands.name: Header
content_islands.spec: Keep the familiar signature, links and actions across the top.

content_islands.name: Announcement
content_islands.spec: Center the headline and explanation within the yellow area.

content_islands.name: Image
content_islands.spec: Let the imaginative scene cross from yellow into the white lower field.

reference_purposes.Intent: The visible paragraph links the updated identity to evolving products and customer needs.
reference_purposes.Application: The source presents a website announcement explaining the redesign.
